description.value: The Blue Horizon is a locally owned, boutique-style hotel occupying a prime spot on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, steps from Stanley Park, English Bay, and the Seawall cycling network. All guest rooms are corner rooms with private step-out balconies, many with views of English Bay and the North Shore mountains. The hotel holds a 3-Green Key Eco-Rating from the Hotel Association of Canada, reflecting a commitment to sustainable operations.
